policies.stock: Stock is a fixed snapshot and does not decrease between invoices. Sum quantities per item on one invoice. quantity greater than stock fails; an equal quantity passes.
policies.duplicates: A duplicate or revision of an already-processed invoice is never paid twice. In a batch, files are sorted by filename. The first file for a normalized invoice number is judged on its own merits. A later file with the same number is not paid.
policies.fx: EUR converts to USD at a fixed rate of 1.10 before the $10,000 check. The payment itself uses the printed amount and currency.
policies.orchestrator: The orchestrator is plain Python in pipeline.py. No agent framework.
